content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Is it possible to simulate analog inputs in a master-slave setup? I am aware that digital inputs can be simulated (as shown in the attached example), but I haven't found a method for analog inputs despite searching help documents and forums. Any advice would be appreciated. Thank you.

Hello, Simulation of a slave device is not possible since it does not execute a program. There’s nothing to simulate if no program runs. With [product_name], you can use a master/master configuration. Communication in network mode between I/O or function blocks can be set up by dragging and dropping between programs, allowing full simulation. The method you found is similar to "forcing," but it only works for digital signals, not for analog signals. Hope this helps.
Thank you, [user_name]. You confirmed what I suspected. It's unfortunate, as this feature would have been very useful for simulation. Regards, [user_name]

[user_name], I’ve been trying to simulate digital inputs in a master-slave arrangement for some time, and your post raised my hopes. However, I checked the screenshot but couldn’t find how to activate the "force" option shown. Is this available in [product_name] software Version 7 (with [article_no]) or Version 8 (with [article_no])? Does it work in LAD mode or only in the FBD programming mode? I’ve tried sample programs in both editors but without success. Any advice would be appreciated. Thank you.

Hello, [user_name], FBD programming with [product_name] is generally more common than LAD. 1. Forcing outputs in function blocks works only in simulation mode and not in online tests. 2. Forcing operates in both FBD and LAD editors, but in LAD, you need to find the correct coil. 3. Since [product_name] Version 8, master/slave isn’t ideal for data exchange. You can use network mode and set up data exchange between [product_name] devices using drag & drop between programs. Benefits: - Simulation is possible - Clear data exchange overview - No extra configuration However, network mode supports only FBD, so it may not suit your needs. Hope this clarifies things.
Hello [user_name], You cannot simulate the digital inputs of the slave [product_name] in a master/slave simulation. However, you can simulate network inputs during simulation.
See attached video; it demonstrates the procedure using [product_name] Version 7 and [article_no].

Hello, Using [product_name] Version 8.1 (English), I tried simulating a network input similar to the method shown in the video posted by [user_name] on 7/27/2016. I received a message: "An exception error occurred. Your data may be inconsistent and subsequent errors may occur. Java.lang.NullPointerException." Has anyone encountered this issue? Additionally, is there still no way to simulate slave analog inputs? Thank you in advance.
I experience the same error; it appears to be a bug in the latest software version. In [product_name] Version 8.0, it works correctly. I am not aware of any way to simulate a slave input.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report difficulties simulating analog inputs in master/slave configurations with [product_name] software. While digital input simulation via forcing is possible, analog signals are not supported in this way. Attempts to simulate network inputs in recent software versions result in errors and exceptions. The absence of these simulation features impacts development, testing, and troubleshooting efficiency.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the ability to simulate both analog and digital inputs across master and slave configurations without encountering software bugs and with consistent behavior across hardware and software versions. They look for comprehensive and seamless simulation capabilities for improved testing and development.
